profile: shore-v1-shaped candidate: explicit corner land profiles, lakeside23 effective land-side mask234; no original outlines measured. Guard through8worldpx and all exterior/filtermargin uses nearest edge: LL field+32, WW -32, mixed signed projection along edge from midpoint positive toward land endpoint. Every shore has exactly two mixededges and one contiguous landarc. Crossings enter along inward unit edge normals for8worldpx; connect anchors A,B with one quintic Bezier, handle h=.24*|B-A|, controls A,A+h*nA,A+2h*nA,B+2h*nB,B+h*nB,B. Equal collinear handles give zero curvature at the straight joins. Add chord-normal displacement .7*64*t^3*(1-t)^3*sin(2*pi*t+.4): value and first two derivatives vanish at anchors. Flatten256 equal parameter steps; signed nearest segment distance in the interior, with160worldpx straight exterior extensions. No nearest-edge field blend or triangular fan in the interior. Shading with S=clamped smoothstep: pure water d<=-5; shallow=blend(water,bank,.16); wet=blend(bank,RGB(33,43,28),.27*(1-S((d+.7)/1.8))); blend water->shallow with S((d+5)/3.3), then ->wet S((d+1.7)/1), then ->grass S((d-.5)/1.9); pure grass d>=2.4. Earth bank spans approximately -1.7..2.4worldpx with soft shallow water to-5. Each blend rounds byteRGB.
